stem:
This excerpt describes a system of government used in Virginia during the 1600s.

Which selection provides the **BEST** example of how the Virginia House of Burgesses influenced the development of representative government in the United States?

options.text: Membership in the Council and . . . in the Assembly . . . was composed . . . of members elected by the people and of [appointed] members of the Council. . . .
Each member had one vote, . . . the governor . . . having the power to veto any measure. . . .
By an extension of usage the Company applied the term “borough” to each area, whether town, hundred, or plantation. . . .
. . . The two classes of members began to sit as separate chambers.

visual_elements: Excerpt from Journals of the House of Burgesses of Virginia, 1619
